title: Wanderburg Mods — Early Access Status & What to Expect
description: Wanderburg mods status in Early Access: no official Steam Workshop or mod API announced yet, what mod support would look like, and safe in-game alternatives.
note: No Steam Workshop page or official mod API was found in research for this wiki. Treat mod support as unannounced until Randwerk confirms it.

paragraphs: As of Steam Early Access (from September 8, 2026), no official mod support, Steam Workshop page, or mod API for Wanderburg has been announced in the materials reviewed here.
This page exists because "wanderburg mods" is a real search — and publishing a fake mod list would be misleading.

sections.h2: What mod support would look like
paragraphs: Steam Workshop integration would let players share modules, vehicles, or balance tweaks through Steam directly.
Wanderburg already builds on modular systems (modules, vehicles, artifacts, captains), so community content would fit its design — but that is speculation, not an announcement.
Watch the Steam news hub and the official Discord for any Workshop or mod-tooling news during Early Access.
Get variety from in-game systems instead of external mods: see the Beginner Guide, Best Build, and Modules pages for legitimate build paths.
Avoid third-party "mod" or "cheat" downloads that claim to modify the game — they are not officially supported and can break your install.

sources: Steam Early Access FAQ on the store page (developer answers)
